findings.reason: without a recorded mesh and route the verdict §3 depends on is not reproducible, so §1's record list must carry the mesh and route (or §2 must name them) before the search runs.
findings.text: §2(1) places its chained MAST-U sequence "at the mesh and solver route §1 recorded", but §1's done-when (plan.html:73) asks its record to state only the coefficient vector, the displaced coordinate/size/sign, the terminal reason and residual and the contour panel, and §1(1) fixes only "the solver's default policy"; no mesh and no solver route is required of the record, so the mesh at which the Reached/Not-reached verdict is taken — the verdict that sets §3's whole scope — is unstated and a worker must guess it or measure at one the plan does not name

findings.reason: the negative control fires only on the refusing route, so the section must name which route the head arm runs on or the control and the head measurement can be of different solves.
findings.text: §4(1) and §4(2) both key on "the route the row-exchange section used", but the record §4 cites for that section (`docs/evidence/fragments/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/efit-on-nova-rows.html`) names the profile-basis route it took and no solver route (`newton_krylov`, `picard`, `anderson`, `reduced_newton`); the receipts §4 cites for the refusal show the batch outcome is route-specific — `picard` and `anderson` run batched (residual 0.03218) and only `newton_krylov`/`reduced_newton` refuse (`TracerArrayConversionError` at `ForwardProfile._solve_accelerated`) — so "that route" is not identifiable and a worker may measure the gated batch on a route the base-revision control cannot falsify

findings.reason: §3's obligation is selected by §2's verdict but names a solve §2 never measures, so the plan must either state that the stored-coefficients default-policy solve is out of §3's arm set or add it to §2's measured set.
findings.text: §3(1) obliges the repair to cover "each solve §1 showed refusing at the base revision … at its recorded coefficients and started from the stored flux map under the default policy", which includes §1(1)'s MAST-U stored-coefficients arm (unqualified at 4.864e-10 against 1e-10, `efit-comparison.html:1593`) as well as the displaced arm; §2 renders a verdict only on the displaced state along the recorded coordinate by a chained sequence under §1(2)'s tightened policy, so no §2 verdict exists for the stored-coefficients default-policy arm — §3 may park it with a Not-reached displaced verdict, or be obliged to repair it on a Reached verdict that measured only the displaced state's reach

findings.reason: a worker composing §4's brief reads a boundary that refuses the very case the section names, so §0 must exempt the batching section (or state its case as beside imas-efit's configuration) before §4 is dispatched.
findings.text: §0's boundary sentence says the plan "takes only the cases that arise beside a stored imas-efit state", while §4 measures the generating state of the nova-written ITER rows (plan.html:108), a case built from nova's own forward solve on the inverse baseline's ITER machine with no stored imas-efit state beside it, so the plan's declared scope excludes its own fourth section's case
